g2-guard-outcome.title: Determine outcome 1/2/3 for the origin-worktree-refusal guard interaction
g2-guard-outcome.imperative: REASONING GATE — no gN-implement/gN-review crew tasks. Crew-waiver reason: same as g1 (LAUNCH_ORDER 'Do not dispatch a crew'); this gate's deliverable is a diagnosis, exactly the kind reasoning gates are for. Investigate whether #441's tests that spawn claim writers out of a pytest tempdir drive an origin-carrying spine through scripts/checklist_engine.py's origin_worktree_refusal guard. Distinguish and record explicitly: (1) nothing breaks — guard never engages, with evidence how that was established; (2) a fixture is dishonest — a bare tempdir stands in for a real git worktree; fix ONLY the specific test fixtures named in File Ownership (tests/test_spine_rail.py / tests/test_gauge_writer.py) by making them honest git repos (git init), exactly as #588's Commander did for tests/test_explorer_templates.py; (3) genuine collision — STOP, do not resolve, report the specific failing case per Stop Conditions. Under no circumstance edit scripts/checklist_engine.py.

preconditions.satisfied_by: merge and map regeneration complete, g1-merge closed

postconditions.statement: outcome (1, 2, or 3) determined and recorded with evidence
postconditions.satisfied_by: OUTCOME 1 -- nothing breaks. Evidence: origin_worktree_refusal() (scripts/checklist_engine.py:102) returns None unconditionally when spine.get('origin') is not a dict (line 152-153), BEFORE it ever reaches the cwd/toplevel check. #441's spawn tests (test_spawn_binding_transaction_red_green, test_spawn_binding_sessionstart_claim_mixed_writer_race in tests/test_spine_rail.py) build their spines via put_checklist()/write_spine(), which write raw {items, tasks} JSON with NO origin key at all -- confirmed by grep '"origin"' tests/test_spine_rail.py tests/test_gauge_writer.py returning zero hits. Direct repro: invoked scripts/checklist_engine.py claim as a subprocess from a bare (non-git) tempdir cwd twice -- once against a spine WITH an origin stamp naming a different worktree (REFUSED, confirming the guard is live and would engage), once against a spine matching put_checklist's shape with NO origin field (claimed successfully, exit 0). Also ran the two spawn tests directly: pytest tests/test_spine_rail.py -k spawn_binding -> 2 passed. tests/test_gauge_writer.py has no spawn/multiprocessing pattern and no origin field either, so it is not implicated. The guard never engages for this lane's tests because none of their spines carry the origin stamp the guard keys on -- not because a fixture masquerades as something it is not.

constraints: fixture fixes limited to tests/test_spine_rail.py and tests/test_gauge_writer.py

constraint: decision:guard-is-untouchable — scripts/checklist_engine.py is merged, not this run's to change
decision: decision:outcome-3-is-a-finding — a genuine collision is reported, not resolved, per LAUNCH_ORDER Pre-Ruling 4
